questions.question_text: What happens if an applicant submits an incomplete application package to PEEF?
options: It is processed normally
It is automatically disqualified
The student is given an indefinite time to complete it
The fund asks for an additional fee to process it
questions.explanation: Incomplete applications fail to provide the necessary information for a fair assessment, and PEEF strict submission guidelines generally lead to disqualification for missing documents.

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a mandatory step during the document submission process?
options: Attesting documents from a Notary Public
Submitting all copies in a specific file folder
Signing the application form as the applicant/guardian
Providing a digital video of family assets
questions.explanation: A signed application serves as a legal declaration that all provided information is accurate and true to the best of the applicant's knowledge.

questions.question_text: What is the primary risk associated with failing to submit the application before the specified deadline?
options: The applicant is given a one-week grace period
The application is rejected without review
The application is marked as 'low priority'
The application fee is refunded
questions.explanation: Adherence to deadlines is a strict administrative rule; late submissions are generally not accepted for fair and timely processing.

questions.question_text: What should an applicant do if they discover they have uploaded a wrong file during an online submission process?
options: Email the PEEF helpdesk immediately with the correct document
Submit a new application from scratch
Ignore the mistake as it will be caught later
Wait for the physical interview to explain
questions.explanation: Proactive communication with the helpdesk allows the administrative team to rectify errors before the evaluation phase begins.

questions.question_text: Why is the 'Affidavit/Undertaking' document signed by the student and the parent?
options: To agree to the terms and conditions regarding the scholarship, including potential repayment if conditions are breached
To confirm they have read the university prospectus
To prove they have an internet connection
To authorize the release of the student's personal photos
questions.explanation: This legal document ensures that both the student and the parent/guardian are aware of and committed to the rules stipulated by the PEEF.

questions.question_text: In the context of document submission, what is the role of an 'Attested Copy'?
options: It confirms that the photocopy is a true representation of the original document
It acts as a substitute for an original degree
It is used only for international applicants
It serves as a receipt for the application fee
questions.explanation: Attestation by a gazetted officer is a verification step that ensures the provided copies are not altered versions of the original records.

questions.question_text: Which method is the most reliable way to confirm that your PEEF application has been successfully submitted?
options: Receiving a system-generated acknowledgement receipt/email
Calling a random university office
Checking with a peer who also applied
Waiting for a phone call from the provincial government
questions.explanation: A system-generated confirmation is the standard and official proof that an application has been received into the database.

questions.question_text: Why is it mandatory for an applicant to provide attested copies of their documents?
options: To make the paperwork look official.
To ensure a third party has verified the copy matches the original document.
To prevent the student from changing the grades on the document.
To increase the processing time for the administration.
questions.explanation: Attestation by a gazetted officer confirms the validity of the copy against the original document.

questions.question_text: What is the consequence of submitting an application after the publicized deadline?
options: The application is automatically rejected.
A late fee of 500 PKR is charged.
The application is processed in the next phase.
The student receives a 10% deduction in marks.
questions.explanation: Deadlines are strictly enforced in competitive scholarship programs; late submissions are generally not considered.

questions.question_text: What should be attached to the application if the applicant is a special needs student?
options: A letter from their friends.
A verified Disability Certificate from a government hospital.
A photo of their medical equipment.
A certificate of good conduct.
questions.explanation: Special quotas require official government-issued verification to ensure the applicant meets the specific eligibility requirements.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the 'Undertaking' signed by both the student and their parent?
options: It is a legal agreement to follow PEEF rules and regulations.
It confirms the parent's income is accurate.
It acts as a receipt for the application fee.
It serves as a letter of recommendation for the student.
questions.explanation: The undertaking is a formal commitment to abide by the PEEF terms, including maintaining academic and conduct standards.

questions.question_text: If an online submission portal allows for file uploads, what is the standard format required to ensure clarity?
options: A blurry screenshot of the document.
A high-resolution PDF scan of the original document.
A text-based description of the document.
A low-quality JPEG image.
questions.explanation: Clear, high-quality digital copies are essential for the verification team to read the details accurately.
